🇲🇽🛢️ <u>OIL BACK OVER $100 — MEXICAN MIX HITS $91.68</u>

Brent crude tore past $100 a barrel this week — peaking at $105.32, its first trip above $100 in two months — as the US-Iran standoff keeps the Strait of Hormuz on edge. El Economista's weekly markets wrap put it plainly: "Petróleo rebasa US$100."

Mexico's export mix rode the wave to $91.68 a barrel — 18% above the $77.30 assumed in the 2026 budget. More dollars for Pemex and Hacienda, while the 24-peso gasoline cap holds at the pump.

🇲🇽🌽 <u>MEXICO CITY OPENS THE "UTOPIA OF CORN" TO DEFEND NATIVE MAIZE</u>

Mexico City just inaugurated the Utopía Centli — the Utopia of Corn — in the Indigenous town of San Miguel Topilejo, Tlalpan.

A 253-million-peso public complex built around a Native Corn Protection Center: seed house, germplasm bank and a lab dedicated to keeping native varieties free of transgenics. Its 50,000 square meters bring free healthcare, sports, culture and childcare to 29,000 residents.

Centli means maíz in náhuatl — the crop Mexico gave the world, protected as public heritage instead of a corporate patent.

🇲🇽🏆 <u>ISAAC DEL TORO, FIRST MEXICAN EVER ON THE TOUR DE FRANCE PODIUM</u>

History for Mexican cycling: Isaac del Toro, the 22-year-old from Ensenada, just finished third overall at the Tour de France — something no Mexican had ever achieved. Only three had even raced the Tour before him.

He also won the white jersey as the race's best young rider, sealing it on the slopes of Alpe d'Huez.

Back home, thousands packed the Ángel de la Independencia to celebrate, and President Sheinbaum joined the congratulations.
banner: DEL TORO: 3RD AT TOUR DE FRANCE

🇲🇽🌎 <u>MILEI ACCUSES MEXICO OF FUNDING "ANTI-ARGENTINA CAMPAIGN" — ZERO PROOF</u>

Argentina's Javier Milei accused Mexico, Brazil and the US Democratic Party of financing an "anti-Argentina campaign" during the World Cup — no documents, no evidence, just a radio rant.

"¿Sabe quién puso más plata en esta campaña antiargentina? El gobierno de Brasil. El 25 por ciento de los recursos salió de ahí," Milei told Radio Mitre, before claiming it "también fue financiada por México."

Brazil has already recalled its ambassador from Buenos Aires. Milei offered nothing to back any of it up.

🇲🇽💧 "The La Parota dam project is cancelled. We are not going to build it, because it severely affected the communities." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, Acapulco, Guerrero The dam on the Papagayo River was resisted by local communities for two decades. In its place, the government is building radial wells and elevated tanks to secure Acapulco's drinking water — part of the reconstruction after hurricanes Otis and John. Hotel occupancy in Acapulco is back to 78%.
